sections.title: Passage 1: Classifying Societies
sections.html:
unequal

(adjective). Không bằng nhau

Ex: The rooms upstairs are of unequal size.

territory

(noun). lãnh thổ

Ex: They have refused to allow UN troops to be stationed in their territory.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

tenant

(noun). Người thuê nhà

Ex: The decorating was done by a previous tenant.

temporary

(adjective). Tạm thời

Ex: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.

stratification

(noun). sự phân tầng

Ex: The prime minister wants to reduce social stratification and make the country a classless society.

separate

(verb). chia tách

Ex: South America and Africa separated 200 million years ago.

residential

(adjective). thích hợp để ở

Ex: It was not safe to locate the chemicals factory in a residential area.

permanent

(adjective). Lâu dài

Ex: She was unable to find a permanent job.

occupy

(verb). chiếm đóng, cư ngụ

Ex: Protesting students occupied the university office for two weeks.

latter

(noun). cái sau

Ex: He presented two solutions. The latter seems much better.

isolated

(adjective). Cô lập

Ex: isolated rural areas Ex: Many of the refugee villages are in isolated areas.

integrate

(verb). Tích hợp

Ex: The department has successfully integrated new ideas into the traditional course structure.

insubstantial

(adjective). mong manh, không vững chắc

Ex: Mars has an insubstantial atmosphere, consisting almost entirely of carbon dioxide.

framework

(noun). Khung sườn

Ex: The report provides a framework for further research.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

Ex: The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.

elaborate

(verb). làm công phu, trau chuốt

Ex: In his plays he takes simple traditional tales and elaborates them.

dwelling

(noun). nơi trú ngụ

Ex: The development will consist of 66 dwellings and a number of offices.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

debris

(noun). mảnh vỡ

Ex: Emergency teams are still clearing the debris from the plane crash.

crucial

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

Ex: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.

criticise

(verb). chỉ trích

Ex: The decision was harshly criticised by environmental groups.

consist

(verb). bao gồm

Ex: The crowd consisted mostly of college kids and office workers.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: the concept that everyone should have equality of opportunity

compose

(verb). soạn, tạo thành

Ex: Ten people compose the committee.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

classify

(verb). Phân loại

Ex: Patients are classified into three categories.

anthropologist

(noun). nhà nhân chủng học

Ex: There were six investigators; four of them were trained anthropologists, the other two were trained for this purpose.

marked

(adjective). rõ ràng, rõ rệt

Ex: The recent advertising campaign has had a marked effect on sales.

formal

(adjective). Có tính nghi thức, lịch sự, trang trọng

Ex: He kept the tone of the letter formal and businesslike.

disparity

(noun). khác biệt

Ex: The wide disparity between rich and poor was highlighted.

status

(noun). cấp bậc, địa vị

Ex: In the teaching of literature, Shakespeare is given a special status.

clan

(noun). gia tộc

Ex: He became clan chief after his father's death.

subsistence

(noun). sinh kế

Ex: Many families are living below the level of subsistence.

rarely

(adverb). hiếm

Ex: The term is rarely used today.

domesticated

(adjective). thuần hóa

Ex: These animals are only partly domesticated.

cultivate

(verb). cày cấy

Ex: The land around here has never been cultivated.

range

(noun). loại

tribe

(noun). bộ lạc

base on

(verb). dựa vào

settlement

(noun). sự định cư

Ex: Early settlement developed around a copper mine.

homestead

(noun). ấp, trại

Ex: What began as a small family homestead is now a 5 000-acre ranch.

dominate

(verb). Thống trị

Ex: The train crash dominated the news.

characteristically

(adverb). một cách đặc trưng

Ex: Her response was characteristically blunt.

senior

(adjective). có thâm niên

Ex: She is senior vice president of marketing.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

prestige

(noun). uy tín, thanh thế

Ex: Winning the prize carries immense prestige.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

hence

(adverb). do đó

govern

(verb). quản lý, điều khiển

Ex: All his decisions have been entirely governed by self-interest.

determine

(verb). Quyết định

Ex: Upbringing plays an important part in determining a person's character.

descent

(noun). nguồn gốc, dòng dõi

Ex: She is Hungarian by descent.

claim

(verb). tuyên bố, cho là

Ex: She's not the saint that many have claimed her to be.

ancestor

(noun). Tổ tiên

Ex: His ancestors had come to America from Ireland.

surplus

(noun). Số dư, số thừa

Ex: After meeting domestic needs, any surplus will be exported.

specialisation

(noun). chuyên môn hóa

Ex: My main specialisation was literature.

periodically

(adverb). định kì

Ex: Mailing lists are updated periodically.

obligation

(noun). Nghĩa vụ

Ex: She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.

chiefdom

(noun). cương vị đứng đầu, chức thủ lĩnh

Ex: The area was divided into independent chiefdoms.

preserve

(verb). Bảo quản, giữ gìn

Ex: Efforts to preserve the peace have failed.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

order

(noun). thứ tự; trật tự

Ex: Some teachers find it difficult to keep their classes in order.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

explicit

(adjective). rõ ràng

Ex: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

enforce

(verb). áp đặt, thực thi

Ex: It's the job of the police to enforce the law.

authority

(noun). uy thế, thẩm quyền

Ex: She now has authority over the people who used to be her bosses.

revenue

(noun). doanh thu, kết quả kinh doanh

Ex: The government is currently facing a shortfall in tax revenue.

receive

(verb). nhận được

Ex: We received a warm welcome from our hosts.

purpose

(noun). mục đích

Ex: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.

principal

(adjective). chính, chủ yếu

Ex: Ex: My principal concern is to get the job done fast.

distribute

(verb). phân bổ, phân phối

Ex: Generous workspaces must be well distributed throughout the library.

bureaucratic

(adjective). thuộc quan lại, thuộc công chức

Ex: The report revealed a great deal of bureaucratic inefficiency.

administration

(noun). việc quản lí

Ex: Administration costs are passed on to the customer.

specialist

(noun). chuyên gia

Ex: This is the view of virtually all independent specialists on the region.

tool

(noun). công cụ

Ex: Always select the right tool for the job.

specific

(adjective). riêng biệt, xác định

Ex: Each debate will focus on a specific political issue.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

typically

(adverb). điển hình

Ex: Typically, the contracts were for five years.

nomadic

(adjective). nay đây mai đó, du cư

Ex: Dating is an obvious problem with this nomadic lifestyle.

livestock

(noun). Gia súc, gia cầm

Ex: The organic livestock industry has grown substantially in the last few years.

intensive

(adjective). tập trung, chuyên sâu, mạnh mẽ

Ex: The course compresses two year's training into six intensive months.

exploitation

(noun). sự lạm dụng, sự khai thác

Ex: Starvation and poverty are the result of global economic exploitation, not lack of resources.

housing

(noun). nhà cửa, chỗ ở

ex: There's a shortage of cheap housing in the region.

early

(adjective). ban sơ, nguyên thủy

Ex: The main construction of the fort belongs to the early medieval period.

cluster

(noun). chùm, cụm

Ex: The telescope is focused on a dense cluster of stars at the edge of the galaxy

arrange

(verb). sắp xếp

Ex: Can I arrange an appointment for Monday?

reward

(noun). phần thưởng

Ex: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.

maintain

(verb). duy trì

Ex: The two countries have always maintained close relations.

goods

(noun). hàng hóa

Ex: The goods will be delivered within ten days.

chief

(noun). lãnh đạo, thủ lĩnh

Ex: A new chief of the security forces has just been appointed.

vary

(verb). Thay đổi, khác nhau

Ex: The students' work varies considerably in quality.

possible

(adjective). có thể

Ex: It is possible to get there by bus.

population

(noun). Dân số

Ex:The country has a total population of 65 million.

generally

(adverb). nhìn chung, đại thể

Ex: These systems generally use solar power.

priest

(noun). linh mục, thầy tu

Ex: Only one or two new priests were ordained each year.

kinsfolk

(noun). họ hàng thân thích

Ex: Kinfolk should help one another.

dweller

(noun). Cư dân

Ex: Apartment dwellers are still primarily couples and singles.

sections.title: Passage 2: Tasmanian Tiger
sections.html:
wisdom

(noun). kiến thức, sự thông thái

Ex: She was known to be a woman of great wisdom.

utterly

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: We're so utterly different from each other.

unsubstantiated

(adjective). không có căn cứ

Ex: There were unsubstantiated rumours of abuse at the prison.

unenviable

(adjective). không gây thèm muốn

Ex: She was given the unenviable task of informing the losers.

supposedly

(adverb). giả định

Ex: The novel is supposedly based on a true story.

slightly

(adverb). nhỏ, không đáng kể

Ex: She earns slightly less than $100 000 a year.

set something apart

(verb). làm cho khác biệt

Ex: Her elegant style sets her apart from other journalists.

ridicule

(noun). chế giễu

Ex: The president was becoming an object of ridicule.

register

(verb). được ghi nhận, được ghi trong tâm trí

Ex: I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.

purportedly

(adverb). tuyên bố, tự nhận, tự cho là

Ex: The study purportedly found that men married to smart women live longer.

prospector

(noun). người điều tra, người tìm kiếm quặng, vàng,...

Ex: A determined prospector found diamonds in Canada's frozen northwest.

proof

(noun). bằng chứng

Ex: These results are a further proof of his outstanding ability.

prime

(adjective). chủ yếu, căn bản

Ex: My prime concern is to protect my property.

pointless

(adjective). vô nghĩa

Ex: We searched until we knew it would be pointless to continue.

optimism

(noun). Tính lạc quan

Ex: We may now look forward with optimism.

officially

(adverb). một cách chính thức

Ex: The royal engagement was announced officially this morning

obsess

(verb). ám ảnh

Ex: He's obsessed by computers.

mythology

(noun). Thần thoại

Ex: Narcissus was a character from Greek mythology.

migratory

(adjective). Có tập tính di cư

Ex: Sea eagles are not migratory, so once extinct, there is no chance of them returning naturally.

irate

(adjective). Giận dữ

Ex: She sounded extremely irate.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

intermittently

(adverb). không liên tục

Ex: The group has met intermittently for several years in an attempt to devise a long-term plan.

insist

(verb). khăng khăng, cố nài

Ex: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.

faith

(noun). niềm tin

Ex: We've lost faith in the government's promises.

fairly

(adverb). vừa phải

Ex: This is a fairly common problem.

fabled

(adjective). nổi tiếng

Ex: Darren Yeadon has spent the past two years in Italy working with marble from Carrara, which has gained a fabled reputation among sculptors across the globe.

escape

(verb). thoát khỏi

Ex: He escaped from prison this morning.

endangered

(adjective). Có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng

Ex: The sea turtle is an endangered species .

distinct

(adjective). khác biệt

Ex: The results of the survey fell into two distinct groups.

cynicism

(noun). hoài nghi

Ex: He's often been accused of cynicism in his attitude towards politics.

consult

(verb). Tham khảo ý kiến

Ex: Have you consulted your lawyer about this?

consensus

(noun). sự thống nhất

Ex: There seems to be a consensus that the plan should be rejected.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

comb

(verb). kiếm cẩn thận

Ex: I combed the shops looking for something to wear.

classify

(verb). Phân loại

Ex: Patients are classified into three categories.

captivity

(noun). sự giam giữ, sự nuôi nhốt

Ex: Animals bred in captivity would probably not survive if they were released into the wild.

blind

(adjective). mù quáng

Ex: blind anger/faith/prejudice Ex: It was a moment of blind panic.

bankrupt

(verb). làm phá sản

Ex: The company was almost bankrupted by legal costs.

authority

(noun). Người có thẩm quyền

Ex: The health authorities are investigating the problem.

authenticity

(noun). tính xác thực

Ex: There has been some debate over the authenticity of his will.

stripe

(noun). sọc

Ex: The zebra is a wild African horse with black and white stripes.

resemble

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

Ex: The plant resembles grass in appearance.

marsupial

(noun). thú có túi

Ex: Marsupials include koalas, possums, and kangaroos.

fur

(noun). lông mao

Ex: She stroked the rabbit's soft fur.

carnivorous

(adjective). Dành cho động vật Ăn thịt

Ex: Farmed cod and haddock are carnivorous and need to be fed other sea fish.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

fossil

(noun). Hoá thạch

Ex: Very few dinosaur fossils are actually found near this boundary.’

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

dig up

(verb). đào bới

Ex: An old Roman vase was dug up here last month.

date from

(verb). có từ, bắt đầu từ

Ex: This map dates from the 14th century.

widespread

(adjective). phổ biến rộng rãi

Ex: The storm caused widespread damage.

disappear

(verb). biến mất

Ex: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.

continent

(noun). Châu lục

Ex: He crossed a whole continent to find his family.

extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

Ex: The red squirrel is in danger of becoming extinct in England.

shrink

(verb). Thu nhỏ

Ex: The market for their products is shrinking.

settler

(noun). người đến định cư

Ex: Most of the settlers came from England.

settlement

(noun). sự định cư

Ex: Early settlement developed around a copper mine.

decline

(verb). sụt giảm

Ex: Support for the party continues to decline.

certainly

(adverb). chắc chắn, nhất định

Ex: Certainly, the early years are crucial to a child's development.

accelerate

(verb). gia tăng, làm nhanh lên

Ex: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.

credible

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

Ex: It is just not credible that he would cheat.

besiege

(verb). bủa vây

Ex: The actress was besieged by reporters at the airport.

attract

(verb). thu hút

Ex: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.

accompany

(verb). Đồng hành

Ex: The text is accompanied by a series of stunning photographs.

trustworthy

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

Ex: Mitchell was a solid and trustworthy man.

plausible

(adjective). hợp lý

Ex: Her story sounded perfectly plausible.

illusion

(noun). Ảo ảnh

Ex: He could no longer distinguish between illusion and reality.

hoax

(noun). chơi khăm

Ex: Detectives are still investigating the hoax calls.

eye-witness

(noun). người chứng kiến tận mắt

Ex: One eyewitness saw the gunmen leave the building.

account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

Ex: The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.

tick along

(verb). vẫn còn hoạt động

Ex: Bankers cut interest rates to keep the global economy ticking along.

sustain

(verb). duy trì, kéo dài

Ex: Which planets can sustain life?

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

inbreeding

(noun). giao phối cận huyết.

Ex: Persistent inbreeding has produced an unusually high frequency of sufferers from this disease.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

certain

(adjective). nhất định

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

unfulfilled

(adjective). không hoàn thiện

Ex: He admitted that he still feels unfulfilled as a footballer.

field

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: The BBC had to field more than 300 phone calls after last night's programme.

countless

(adjective). không đếm xuể

Ex: I've warned her countless times.

convince

(verb). thuyết phục

Ex: I'd be very surprised if this argument convinces anybody.

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

extinction

(noun). Sự tuyệt chủng

Ex:The island's way of life is doomed to extinction.

disturb

(verb). làm phiền

Ex: Some scenes are violent and may disturb younger viewers.

report

(verb). kể lại, thuật lại

Ex: The assassination was reported in all the newspapers.

interpretation

(noun). Sự diễn giải

Ex: Her evidence suggests a different interpretation of the events.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

striped

(adjective). có sọc

Ex: Do you prefer plain or striped shirts?

remain

(verb). vẫn, giữ như cũ

Ex: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.

inspire

(verb). Truyền cảm hứng

Ex: The actors inspired the kids with their enthusiasm.

extensive

(adjective). bao quát, rộng rãi

Ex: Extensive research has been done into this disease.

bemused

(adjective). bối rối, khó hiểu

Ex: Sarah looked totally bemused.

specimen

(noun). tiêu bản

Ex: He has a collection of rare insect specimens.

notoriously

(adverb). Khét tiếng

Ex: Mountain weather is notoriously difficult to predict.

mistake

(verb). nhầm lẫn

Ex: You can't mistake their house - it has a bright yellow front door.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

elusive

(adjective). Khó nắm bắt

Ex: Truth is a notoriously elusive quality.

drag

(verb). kéo

Ex: Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!

treat

(verb). xem xét, coi như

Ex: I decided to treat his remark as a joke.

make a fool of somebody

(verb). đem ai làm trò cười

Ex: Can't you see she's making a fool of you?

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

Ex: They immediately began arguing.

face value

(noun). giá trị bề ngoài

Ex: For the first week he never actually saw the fabled Jack.

embarrass

(verb). làm xấu hổ

Ex: Her questions about my private life embarrassed me.

creditable

(adjective). vẻ vang, đáng khen ngợi

Ex: It was a very creditable result for the team.

claim

(verb). tuyên bố, cho là

Ex: She's not the saint that many have claimed her to be.

sections.title: Passage 3: Accidental Scientists
sections.html:
vigorously

(adverb). mạnh bạo, dữ dội

Ex: The accusation was vigorously denied.

unintentionally

(adverb). vô tình, không chủ ý

Ex: They had unintentionally provided wrong information.

unforeseen

(adjective). không lường trước được

Ex: The project was running late owing to unforeseen circumstances.

sufficiency

(noun). đầy đủ

Ex: Will there still be a sufficiency of resources for our great-grandchildren?

serendipity

(noun). sự tình cờ may mắn

Ex: Meeting her like that, and there of all places, was true serendipity!

secularism

(noun). chủ nghĩa thế tục

Ex: His parents tolerate the sudden plunge into secularism with helpless concern

rigid

(adjective). cứng rắn, nghiêm khắc

Ex: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.

potential

(adjective). Tiềm năng

Ex: We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.

parallel

(noun). tương đồng, tương tự

Ex: This tradition has no parallel in our culture.

out of the question

(adjective). miễn bàn

Ex: Another trip abroad this year is out of the question.

ivory tower

(noun). sự ẩn dật để suy tưởng và tránh thực tại

Ex: Jenkins should get down from his ivory tower and sample the real world.

invariably

(adverb). lúc nào cũng vậy

Ex: This is not invariably the case.

inspection

(noun). sự kiểm tra

Ex: Regular inspections are carried out at the prison.

inductivism

(noun). cách diễn giải quy nạp

Ex: The author ignores another problem with inductivism, widely elaborated in philosophy.

in quest of

(conjunction). truy tìm

Ex: He set off in quest of adventure.

ignorant

(adjective). dốt nát

Ex: Never make your students feel ignorant.

groundwork

(noun). nền, cơ sở

Ex: The first year provides the basic groundwork for the pupils’ study of maths.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

determinate

(adjective). xác định, nhất định

Ex: A determinate sentence of imprisonment was imposed.

curiosity

(noun). Sự tò mò

Ex:His answer did not satisfy my curiosity at all.

constructive

(adjective). Mang tính xây dựng

Ex: You should always welcome constructive criticism of your work.

bearing

(noun). mối liên hệ

Ex: Regular exercise has a direct bearing on fitness and health.

assist

(verb). Hỗ trợ

Ex: We are looking for people who would be willing to assist in the group's work.

adequate

(adjective). Cân xứng, đầy đủ

Ex: They'll need an adequate supply of hot water.

paradox

(noun). nghịch lý

Ex: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.

notion

(noun). khái niệm

Ex: She had only a vague notion of what might happen.

contradiction

(noun). Sự mâu thuẫn

Ex: His public speeches are in direct contradiction to his personal lifestyle.

anticipate

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.

outcome

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: We are confident of a positive outcome.

discovery

(noun). khám phá

Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý

Ex: I recommend the book to all my students.

latter

(noun). cái sau

Ex: He presented two solutions. The latter seems much better.

former

(noun). cái trước

Ex: He had to choose between giving up his job and giving up his principles. He chose the former.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

expectation

(noun). Kì vọng

Ex: He failed to live up to his parents' expectations.

reside

(verb). hiện có, tập trung vào, thuộc về

Ex: Happiness does not reside in strength or money.

ideal

(adjective). Lý tưởng

Ex: This beach is ideal for children.

compose

(verb). soạn, tạo thành

Ex: Ten people compose the committee.

alternative

(adjective). khác

Ex: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

accidental

(adjective). tình cờ

Ex: I didn't think our meeting was accidental—he must have known I would be there.

unexpected

(adjective). không ngờ, thình lình

Ex: The film has some unexpected twists.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

rummage

(verb). đào bới

Ex: She was rummaging around in her bag for her keys.

rhetoric

(noun). lối nói hoa mỹ, khoa trương

Ex: He was prepared to use militant rhetoric in attacking his opponents.

occurrence

(noun). lần xuất hiện, sự xảy ra

Ex: The program counts the number of occurrences of any word within the text.

knack

(noun). sở trường

Ex: He's got a real knack for making money.

emphasize

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.

dwell on

(verb). nghĩ đi nghĩ lại

Ex: I don't want to dwell on this subject for too long.

dispute

(noun). Xung đột, tranh cãi

Ex: The union is in dispute with management over working hours.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

antiquarian

(noun). người sưu tập/ người nghiên cứu đồ cổ

Ex: To all antiquarians these forests are of particular interest.

capacity

(noun). khả năng

Ex: She has an enormous capacity for hard work.

insist

(verb). khăng khăng, cố nài

Ex: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.

rational

(adjective). Hợp lý, mang tính lý trí

Ex: There is no rational explanation for his actions.

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

treat

(verb). xem xét, coi như

Ex: I decided to treat his remark as a joke.

sagacity

(noun). khôn ngoan

Ex: His air of kindness and sagacity tempts people to confide in him.

misunderstanding

(noun). hiểu nhầm

Ex: The meeting is a final chance to clear up any misunderstandings.

favor

(verb). ủng hộ, thích dùng hơn

Ex: These are the running shoes favored by marathon runners.

exploit

(verb). khai thác

Ex: The company has been successful in exploiting new technology to the full.

dissolve into

(verb). biến thành, trở nên

Ex: She knew if she looked at her friend that she’d dissolve into laughter.

ambiguity

(noun). sự mơ hồ

Ex: Write clear definitions in order to avoid ambiguity.

incendiary

(adjective). phá đám, gây bất hòa

Ex: incendiary remarks Ex: During that year the rhetoric on both sides reached the incendiary stage.

expertise

(noun). Chuyên môn

Ex: We have the expertise to help you run your business.

denigration

(noun). sự phỉ báng, sự bôi nhọ

Ex: Many have objected to the song's denigration of women.

spontaneity

(noun). tính tự phát, tính tự nhiên, không ép buộc

Ex: There is a lack of spontaneity in her performance.

sector

(noun). khu vực

Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.

regimentation

(noun). sự tổ chức thành đoàn

Ex: She rebelled against the regimentation of school life.

pioneer

(noun). người tiên phong, người mở đường

Ex: The pioneers went west across North America, cutting down forests and planting new crops.

occur

(verb). xảy ra

Ex: Three major events occurred in my life that year.

inhabitant

(noun). Cư dân

Ex: It is a town of about 10 000 inhabitants.

illustration

(noun). ví dụ sinh động

Ex: The statistics are a clear illustration of the point I am trying to make.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

corporate

(adjective). tập đoàn

Ex: Their corporate headquarters are in Boston.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

contest

(verb). tranh cãi, tranh luận

Ex: Defence lawyers successfully contested the case.

commit

(verb). cam kết

Ex: Both candidates refused to commit themselves to tax cuts.

capitalism

(noun). chủ nghĩa tư bản

Ex: the growth of industrial capitalism in the West

autonomy

(noun). sự tự chủ, sự tự quản

Ex: We need to preserve the professional autonomy of the scientific community.

uncertainty

(noun). Sự không chắc chắn, thiếu rõ ràng

Ex: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.

productive

(adjective). hiệu suất tốt

Ex: My time spent in the library was very productive.

policy

(noun). chính sách

Ex: The company has adopted a firm policy on shoplifting.

misconception

(noun). sự hiểu sai

Ex: Their views are based on misconception and prejudice.

undertake

(verb). đảm đương

Ex: University professors both teach and undertake research.

senior

(adjective). có thâm niên

Ex: She is senior vice president of marketing.

represent

(verb). đại diện, biểu trưng

Ex: The artist uses doves to represent peace.

predict

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: Nobody could predict the outcome.

match

(verb). phù hợp với

Ex: Investment in hospitals is needed now to match the future needs of the country.

keystone

(noun). yếu tố chủ chốt

Ex: Changes to the welfare system are the keystone of the government’s reforms.

impact

(noun). tác động

Ex: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

formulate

(verb). đề ra, tạo ra

Ex: His ideas are always very carefully formulated.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

endemic

(adjective). phổ biến

Ex: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.

criterion

(noun). tiêu chí

Ex: She failed to meet the strict selection criteria.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

Ex: Remember that actions have consequences.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

whatsoever

(adverb). bất kể thứ gì

Ex: They received no help whatsoever.

purist

(noun). người theo chủ nghĩa thuần túy

Ex: Some purists complain that the buildings are not being accurately restored.

premise

(noun). tiền đề

Ex: His reasoning is based on the premise that all people are equally capable of good and evil.

philosophy

(noun). Triết lý

Ex: Her philosophy of life is to take every opportunity that presents itself.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

systematise

(verb). sắp xếp theo hệ thống

Ex: The mentoring process needs to be systematised in order to be truly effective.

indeed

(adverb). thật vậy, hiển nhiên

Ex: Thank you very much indeed!

process

(noun). quá trình

Ex: It's a normal part of the learning process.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

devalue

(verb). làm giảm giá trị

Ex: Work in the home is often ignored and devalued.

benign

(adjective). nhẹ nhàng

Ex: The industry's environmental impact is relatively benign, even positive.

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

Ex: The basis of a good marriage is trust.

authority

(noun). uy thế, thẩm quyền

Ex: She now has authority over the people who used to be her bosses.

rationality

(noun). sự hợp lí

Ex: Science rests on the ideals of objectivity and rationality.

mature

(adjective). Trưởng thành

Ex: Jane is very mature for her age.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

argue

(verb). tranh luận

Ex: Critics argue that Britain is not investing enough in broadband.

rarely

(adverb). hiếm

Ex: The term is rarely used today.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột, mâu thuẫn

Ex: The violence was the result of political and ethnic conflicts.

reality

(noun). thực tại

Ex: He refuses to face reality

note

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: It should be noted that dissertations submitted late will not be accepted.

fairy tale

(noun). chuyện cổ tích, chuyện thần tiên

Ex: I dreamed of living in a flat like that and used to spend hours looking at the pictures like a child immersed in a fairy tale.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.
